SharedFlowBundle.name: SF-Signature-Validator
SharedFlowBundle.Description: Single entry point for signature validation at the gateway (the API itself provides no validation method). Calling API proxies set the signature.verify.type flow variable (jwt | cavage | xmldsig) and invoke this shared flow via FlowCallout; it routes to the matching sub-step. JWT/JWS is fully native (VerifyJWS, keyed from an Apigee KeyStore reference). Cavage and XML-DSig verify everything achievable without real RSA/ECDSA math (the signing string / digest) natively in JS, and fault via a clearly marked NI-*-Verify-Signature placeholder for the actual cryptographic check, which needs a JavaCallout — Apigee has no native policy for either, and JS can't reach KeyStore key material to do that math itself.
